result: If I had the power to change the world in one way, I would strive to ensure universal access to quality education for all. Education is a powerful tool that can help break the cycle of poverty, promote gender equality, and foster global peace and understanding. It empowers individuals and equips them with the knowledge and skills necessary to contribute to their communities and the world. By ensuring that everyone has access to quality education, we can create a more equitable and sustainable world for all.
